apps.name: LINKING
apps.about: A two-player strategy board game of diagonal lines, clashes and breakthroughs. Play the computer, a friend on one phone, or a friend's phone nearby over Bluetooth.

apps.name: ContactSync
apps.about: Choose who lands in your phone contacts: people with your tags, buyers or sellers, a state, an age range. They get your number too, always both ways. Android, 18+.

promo.text: Early tester bonus: your first month is free, plus 6 more months with this code (first 100 testers).
promo.where: After you sign in: Profile > Subscription > Have a code?

apps.after_install: Open ContactSync and sign in with your WhatsApp number. Then claim your bonus: Profile > Subscription > Have a code?

apps.name: Bitnook
apps.about: A shelf of tiny web games that live on your phone, and a way to hand one to a friend. No account, no server, no feed — a game is a single HTML file that runs sealed off, with no network of its own. Pass one the way you'd pass a photo.
